projectTitle: rePhlow: A modular synthetic-biology platform for phosphorus capture and valorisation from industrial wastewater
projectTitle_zh: rePhlow：一個用於從工業廢水中捕集並加值利用磷的模組化合成生物學平台
tagline: Phosphorus should not reach nature as pollution, and it should not leave industry as waste.
tagline_zh: 磷不該以污染的形式進入自然，也不該以廢棄物的形式離開工業。
summary: rePhlow intercepts phosphorus in a defined industrial wastewater stream rather than attempting to 'solve eutrophication'. An immobilised enzyme panel (phosphatases, phospholipases, phytase) releases phosphorus from organic and condensed fractions; engineered Pseudomonas putida KT2440 carrying heterologous ppk1 and the Accumulibacter Pst high-affinity transport system, with pitB/ppx/ppkB knocked out by CRISPR base editing, accumulates it as polyphosphate inside core-shell alginate-chitosan capsules; the recovered polyP then feeds a coupled PPK2/DHAK biocatalytic cascade producing dihydroxyacetone phosphate. The capsules sit in a basket-type rotating-bed bioreactor the team built themselves, with encapsulation doubling as the EU contained-use regulatory strategy. The project is explicitly framed as a two-sided business: paid to remove phosphorus, paid again for the phosphorus recovered.
summary_zh: rePhlow 選擇在一條明確界定的工業廢水流中攔截磷，而不是試圖「解決優養化」。一組固定化酶（磷酸酶、磷脂酶、植酸酶）先把磷從有機態與縮合態組分中釋放出來；經改造的 Pseudomonas putida KT2440 帶有異源 ppk1 與 Accumulibacter 的 Pst 高親和性運輸系統，並以 CRISPR 鹼基編輯剔除 pitB/ppx/ppkB，在核殼式海藻酸鹽-幾丁聚醣膠囊內把磷累積成聚磷酸鹽；回收得到的 polyP 再送入 PPK2/DHAK 偶聯的生物催化串聯，生產磷酸二羥丙酮。這些膠囊放在團隊自行打造的籃式旋轉床生物反應器中，而包覆本身同時就是歐盟封閉使用（contained use）的法規策略。這個專案明確定位為一門雙邊收費的事業：除磷收一次錢，回收到的磷再收一次。

dry.frameworks: A genome-scale constraint-based model of P. putida KT2440 (iJN1463, 2,927 reactions) was used to ask which conditions and genes actually limit polyphosphate accumulation, then systematically reduced to a kinetic model. Parsimonious FBA identified the active metabolic core, flux variability analysis separated reactions with real flexibility (respiration, redox balancing) from those that are merely accessory, and flux coupling analysis justified lumping the Entner-Doudoroff route into one net reaction while deliberately keeping oxidative phosphorylation as its own module. The result is a 45-reaction core and then a handful of lumped modules in which every rate law can be written and every parameter traced to a source. The team states plainly what the model cannot do: no explicit genetic or enzymatic regulation, borrowed kinetic constants from related species, the anaerobic half of an EBPR process not modelled, and conclusions valid only for aerobic polyP accumulation on a fixed medium.
dry.frameworks_zh: 團隊以 P. putida KT2440 的基因組尺度限制式模型（iJN1463，2,927 個反應）去問：到底哪些條件與基因真正限制了聚磷酸鹽的累積，再系統性地把它縮減成一個動力學模型。簡約通量平衡分析（pFBA）找出活躍的代謝核心，通量變異性分析把真正具有彈性的反應（呼吸作用、氧化還原平衡）與僅屬附屬的反應區分開來，而通量耦合分析則為把 Entner-Doudoroff 途徑併為單一淨反應提供了依據，同時刻意保留氧化磷酸化作為獨立模組。結果是一個 45 個反應的核心，外加少數幾個集總模組，其中每一條速率式都寫得出來、每一個參數都能追溯到來源。團隊也明白說出模型做不到什麼：沒有明確的基因或酵素層級調控、動力學常數借自近緣物種、EBPR 製程的厭氧那一半並未建模，以及結論僅適用於固定培養基下的好氧 polyP 累積。
dry.dataviz: An interactive D3 force-directed metabolic flux map (shipped as a separate MetabolicNetworkGraph chunk) renders the 45-reaction core with line thickness proportional to pFBA flux and grey lines for zero-flux branches. Plotly-gl3d renders phenotype phase planes for PolyP flux over glucose x O2 and phosphate x glucose uptake. The sustainability page carries an interactive LCA slider that moves capsule phosphorus loading from 0 to 12 mg P/g and shows which side of the ~8 mg P/g climate crossover a given loading falls on. The entrepreneurship page carries a customer-facing sizing and quotation demo built on the team's own financial model.
dry.dataviz_zh: 一張互動式 D3 力導向代謝通量圖（以獨立的 MetabolicNetworkGraph 區塊載入）呈現 45 個反應的核心，線條粗細與 pFBA 通量成正比，零通量分支以灰線表示。Plotly-gl3d 繪製了 PolyP 通量在葡萄糖 x O2 以及磷酸鹽 x 葡萄糖攝取兩組座標下的表型相平面。永續性頁面放了一個互動式 LCA 滑桿，可把膠囊的磷負載量由 0 調到 12 mg P/g，並顯示某一負載量落在約 8 mg P/g 氣候衝擊交叉點的哪一側。創業頁面則放了一個面向客戶的規模估算與報價示範，建立在團隊自己的財務模型之上。
dry.datascience: Single-variable sensitivity sweeps on ammonium, phosphate and oxygen uptake capacity, ATP-maintenance demand (ATPM as an energetic stress proxy) and PPK1 capacity as a multiple of the reference pFBA flux, yielding concrete predictions: PPK1 is essential but its reference capacity is already sufficient, and nitrogen limitation permits rather than forces polyP storage. On the commercial side, a ten-year financial model with declared sensitivity: capsule service life drives everything, giving a Year-5 gross margin of 54.7% at 500 reuse cycles, 25.7% at 100 cycles and -10.6% at 50. The LCA is run with an explicit sensitivity on phosphorus captured per gram of capsule.
dry.datascience_zh: 團隊對銨、磷酸鹽與氧的攝取能力、ATP 維持需求（以 ATPM 作為能量壓力的代理指標），以及 PPK1 容量（以參考 pFBA 通量的倍數表示）做了單變數敏感度掃描，得到具體預測：PPK1 不可或缺，但其參考容量已經足夠，而氮限制是允許而非強迫 polyP 儲存。商業面則有一套十年財務模型並明白標示敏感度：膠囊使用壽命主導一切，在重複使用 500 次時第 5 年毛利率為 54.7%、100 次時為 25.7%、50 次時則為 -10.6%。LCA 也以每公克膠囊所捕集的磷量做了明確的敏感度分析。
dry.software: An ISO 14040/14044-aligned life cycle assessment built in openLCA over 16 impact categories, with the openLCA workbook, the full LCA report and a step-by-step LCA tutorial published as a reusable contribution for other iGEM teams. Protein work used PROSS (phylogenetic sequence information plus Rosetta energy calculations) for DHAK stabilisation, AlphaFold for SpyTag/SpyCatcher fusion models, PyMOL for superposition onto PDB 1UN9, and SWISS-MODEL homology models to guide affinity-tag placement and expression-host choice.
dry.software_zh: 一份符合 ISO 14040/14044 的生命週期評估，以 openLCA 建立，涵蓋 16 個衝擊類別；openLCA 工作檔、完整 LCA 報告與一份逐步操作的 LCA 教學都已公開，作為可供其他 iGEM 團隊重複使用的貢獻。蛋白質工作方面，DHAK 的穩定化使用 PROSS（親緣序列資訊加上 Rosetta 能量計算），SpyTag/SpyCatcher 融合模型使用 AlphaFold，並以 PyMOL 疊合到 PDB 1UN9，另以 SWISS-MODEL 同源模型指引親和標籤的放置位置與表現宿主的選擇。
techniques: ODE kinetic modelling with traced parameters

good.publicEngagement: A public survey found respondents rated their own knowledge of water pollution at 2.4 out of 5 and only 54% knew phosphorus can become a contaminant, yet 89% would support recycling phosphorus from wastewater into a useful resource, and views on GM microorganisms for treatment leaned favourable. The team's conclusion is unusually specific and actionable: the barrier to acceptance is not resistance to the biotechnology but the invisibility of the problem. Outreach leaned on science comedy, a format the team actually won with: Diego performed monologues at the National Museum of Natural Sciences (MNCN-CSIC) and the Museum of Human Evolution in Burgos, and took first place at the 4th Monologos de Ciencia Complutense. Other activities were school talks at IES Alameda de Osuna and IES Humanejos, a live alginate-bead synthesis demonstration at Madrid es Ciencia, a talk to DIS Abroad Scandinavia students at Compluemprende covering both the science and the business model, a hands-on session at the Lamarr vocational camp, and best-poster plus best-oral-presentation awards at the XVIII UCM Health Sciences Students' Congress, where veterinary professionals raised animal toxin exposure in eutrophic waters as an angle the team had not considered. The team also hosted the iGEM European Meetup in Malaga, submitted to the MSP-Vector peer-reviewed iGEM journal (ranked among the three best submissions and refereeing three other teams' papers in turn), and ran a joint 'war on two fronts' campaign with iGEM UPF Barcelona's Vinesys contrasting water scarcity with nutrient pollution.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 一份公眾問卷發現，受訪者自評對水污染的了解程度為 5 分中的 2.4 分，只有 54% 知道磷可能成為污染物，但有 89% 支持把廢水中的磷回收成有用資源，而對於使用基改微生物處理廢水的看法則偏向正面。團隊的結論異常具體且可行動：接受度的障礙不在於對生物技術的抗拒，而在於這個問題本身看不見。科普推廣主要倚重科學喜劇，而這也是團隊真正拿下名次的形式：Diego 在國立自然科學博物館（MNCN-CSIC）與 Burgos 的人類演化博物館表演科學單口，並在第 4 屆 Monologos de Ciencia Complutense 奪得第一名。其他活動包括在 IES Alameda de Osuna 與 IES Humanejos 的校園演講、在 Madrid es Ciencia 現場示範海藻酸鹽珠的合成、在 Compluemprende 向 DIS Abroad Scandinavia 的學生講授科學內容與商業模式、在 Lamarr 技職營隊的動手課程，以及在第 18 屆 UCM 健康科學學生研討會同時獲得最佳海報與最佳口頭報告獎，會上獸醫專業人士提出了優養化水域中動物接觸毒素的議題，這是團隊原本沒有想到的切角。團隊另主辦了在 Malaga 舉行的 iGEM 歐洲聚會，並投稿至同儕審查的 iGEM 期刊 MSP-Vector（獲評為三篇最佳投稿之一，並反過來為另外三支團隊的論文擔任審稿），還與 iGEM UPF Barcelona 的 Vinesys 合辦了一場「兩線作戰」聯合宣傳，把缺水與營養鹽污染並置對照。
good.ihp: This is one of the most rigorously structured integrated human practices sections of the year, and the structure is the contribution. The team adapted the EPSRC AREA framework (Anticipate, Reflect, Engage, Act) because it found that 'safe' and 'responsible' meant different things to different team members, and built a five-rung integration ladder with an explicit closure criterion: relevant concern recorded (consultation only); input produced a traceable modification; modification entered a construct, protocol, experiment, model or communication output; evidence generated to assess the modified design; the revised design taken back to the person whose input triggered it; and only when their response produces a further change is the loop described as closed. Twenty-five stakeholder encounters are documented with date, affiliation, the question asked, the challenge raised and what changed. The strongest chain starts with Bio-Oils Huelva's La Rabida biodiesel plant (20 March 2025), which described the phosphorus concentration, pH and temperature of its degumming effluent and warned that any new treatment would have to fit around existing infrastructure; the team turned those ranges into a semi-synthetic effluent recipe used before any real sample existed, made modular retrofit-compatibility an explicit design requirement ('a mid-sized industrial facility cannot rebuild its infrastructure around an experimental technology'), and later ran the engineered strain on real Bio-Oils effluent, where it accumulated more phosphorus than the wild type and survived. Aurelio Hidalgo (CBM, CSIC-UAM) reframed the enzyme problem before any design was fixed: 'an enzyme that is simply expressed and released is spent once; at the scale of a treatment stream, a single-use biocatalyst is neither economical nor recoverable', which killed both of the team's placeholders (secretion and a consortium) and moved the enzyme panel onto a reusable solid support, cleanly separating phosphorus release from uptake and storage. Silvia Diaz del Toro then pointed out that nothing in the design distinguished an enzyme that was immobilised from one verified to stay immobilised, so enzyme retention and leaching became explicit safety requirements and the immobilisation chemistry was selected to minimise detachment rather than to maximise activity; Juan Manuel Bolivar converted that into a de-risked model system with a characterised support, a characterised enzyme and an assay that works at the acidic pH the real enzymes need, because the team's first colorimetric assay would have failed there. Repsol (21 October 2025) said flatly that living GMOs would not be acceptable without convincing evidence that environmental release had been prevented, which elevated containment evidence above removal performance as a condition for implementation and generated a culture plus qPCR monitoring campaign with a divert-and-inactivate protocol. CEDEX, the public water-technology research body, told the team its malachite-green assay should not be presented as equivalent to an official reference method, after which rePhlow was reframed as a complement to established treatment rather than a replacement and method validation was written in as a necessary next step. The closed loop the team is proudest of is materials: Carmen Garcia Payo and Loreto Garcia Fernandez proposed core-shell capsules over simple beads, the team built them but could not see the internal structure, took that problem straight back to the same researchers, and received magnetite as an optical tracer plus cryosectioning, which became a wall-thickness measurement and leakage-testing pipeline. Two further things lift this above a meeting log: the team documents a change it chose not to make (Elvira Mateos' Accumulibacter polyamine route, declined because the metabolic burden outweighed an unquantifiable gain, written up explicitly because 'not adding a pathway is a design decision too'), and it records a non-expert voice, Inmaculada Alonso, a long-term resident near the San Juan reservoir, who described eutrophication as a slow change she had watched for decades without ever being told why. That conversation shifted the team towards perceptible restoration outcomes and clear communication as deliverables, and the team itself notes that one resident cannot represent everyone affected.
good.ihp_zh: 這是今年結構最嚴謹的整合式人類實踐章節之一，而這個結構本身就是貢獻。團隊改用了 EPSRC 的 AREA 框架（Anticipate、Reflect、Engage、Act），原因是他們發現「安全」與「負責」對不同團員而言意思並不相同；他們並建立了一個五階整合階梯，附明確的閉環判準：記錄到相關疑慮（僅為諮詢）；意見產生了可追溯的修改；修改進入了某個構築體、實驗流程、實驗、模型或溝通產出；產生了證據以評估修改後的設計；修改後的設計被帶回給當初提出意見的人；而只有當對方的回應又再引發一次改變時，這個迴圈才被稱為閉合。25 場利害關係人接觸都記錄了日期、單位、所問的問題、對方提出的挑戰，以及因此改變了什麼。最強的一條鏈始於 Bio-Oils Huelva 的 La Rabida 生質柴油廠（2025 年 3 月 20 日），該廠說明了其脫膠廢水的磷濃度、pH 與溫度，並警告任何新處理技術都必須配合既有設施；團隊把這些範圍轉成一份半合成廢水配方，在拿到任何真實樣本之前就先使用，並把模組化的改裝相容性列為明確的設計要求（「一座中型工業廠不可能為了一項實驗性技術重建自己的基礎設施」），後來也把工程菌株放到真實的 Bio-Oils 廢水中運行，結果累積的磷比野生型更多且存活下來。Aurelio Hidalgo（CBM, CSIC-UAM）在任何設計定案之前就重新框定了酶的問題：「一個只是表現出來並釋放到環境中的酶，用一次就沒了；在處理一整條廢水流的規模上，單次使用的生物催化劑既不經濟也無法回收」，這句話否決了團隊原本的兩個暫定方案（分泌表現與菌群共培養），把酶組移到可重複使用的固體載體上，乾淨地把磷的釋放與磷的吸收儲存分開。接著 Silvia Diaz del Toro 指出，設計中並沒有任何東西能區分「已被固定化的酶」與「經驗證會持續固定不脫落的酶」，於是酶的保留率與流失成為明確的安全要求，固定化化學的選擇標準也改為最小化脫落，而不是最大化活性；Juan Manuel Bolivar 則把這一點轉化成一個已去風險的模式系統，包含一個已表徵的載體、一個已表徵的酶，以及一套能在真實酶所需的酸性 pH 下運作的分析方法，因為團隊最初的呈色分析法在那個 pH 下會失效。Repsol（2025 年 10 月 21 日）直言，若無法提供足以說服人的證據證明已防止環境釋放，活體 GMO 不會被接受，這使「圍阻的證據」在實施條件上的位階高於除磷效能，並促成了一套培養加 qPCR 的監測計畫，以及一份分流並去活化的處置流程。公立水處理技術研究機構 CEDEX 告訴團隊，他們的孔雀綠呈色法不應被呈現為等同官方參考方法，此後 rePhlow 被重新定位為既有處理程序的補充而非替代，方法確效也被寫入為必要的下一步。團隊最自豪的閉合迴圈出現在材料上：Carmen Garcia Payo 與 Loreto Garcia Fernandez 建議採用核殼式膠囊而非單純的珠體，團隊做出來了卻看不到內部結構，於是把這個問題直接帶回給同一批研究人員，得到磁鐵礦作為光學示蹤劑以及冷凍切片的建議，最後發展成一套壁厚量測與滲漏測試流程。另有兩件事讓這一章超越了會議紀錄：團隊記錄了一項他們決定不做的改動（Elvira Mateos 提出的 Accumulibacter 多胺途徑，因代謝負擔大於無法量化的效益而婉拒，並特意寫下來，因為「不加入一條途徑同樣是一個設計決定」）；以及他們記錄了一位非專家的聲音，Inmaculada Alonso，San Juan 水庫附近的長期居民，她描述優養化是一種她看了幾十年、卻從來沒有人向她解釋過原因的緩慢變化。那場對話讓團隊轉向把「可被感知的復原成果」與「清楚的溝通」當成交付項目，而團隊自己也指出，一位居民無法代表所有受影響的人。
good.realWorld: Need is framed with its own data, not a logo wall: 63% of assessed inland water bodies already eutrophic, ~1.15 million km2 of coastal waters with eutrophication potential, and the Mar Menor as a named Spanish case where a 2016 bloom destroyed over 80% of seagrass meadows, local income fell by an estimated share relative to unaffected areas and property values dropped. The team visited Mar Menor, Donana and the Embalse de San Juan to ground this. Nine SDG interactions were scored using the seven-point Nilsson, Griggs and Visbeck framework across SDGs 6, 9, 12, 13 and 14, and 22 stakeholder conversations were tracked through a Sustainability Model Canvas adapted from iGEM Hangzhou-BioX 2024, with six of them traced to engineering decisions and open loops marked as open. The most credible single act on this page is self-contradiction: the team's own ISO 14040/44 openLCA study over 16 impact categories finds that at the capsule loading it has actually achieved (1.5 mg P/g) rePhlow has a HIGHER climate-change impact than the chemical precipitation comparator, identifies phosphorus captured per gram of capsule as the single reversing variable, and publishes the ~8 mg P/g crossover rather than listing an achievement its own instruments contradict. Regulation is handled as strategy rather than context: Directive (EU) 2024/3019 replaces the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive from August 2027 with phosphorus limits phased 2033-2045, but the team notes the binding obligation for its customer is the facility permit, not the urban Directive, and that EU law distinguishes contained use of GM microorganisms from deliberate release, making encapsulation plus downstream ultrafiltration a regulatory pathway as much as a safety feature; contained-use notification carries real 45-day and 90-day administrative lead times that are placed on the critical path. The cost model is stated as assumption, not result, at TRL 2-3: Business Plan V3 gives EUR 9,460 direct cost per module at a 50.2% gross margin, a pilot at EUR 69,800 of equipment plus EUR 450,000 cash cost, EUR 20,000 founder capital matched to the minimum share capital of the national technology-company grant line (up to EUR 250,000 at 70% of a >=EUR 175,000 budget), and a declared cost-of-goods sensitivity modelled twice at laboratory and bulk industrial prices. Two revenue models are offered: direct purchase of the module plus consumables and service, or Phosphorus-as-a-Service in which rePhlow retains ownership and therefore carries the capsule-lifetime risk itself. The beachhead is mid-sized agro-industrial and biofuel facilities with Bio-Oils Huelva as first prospective customer, and the four-phase plan has hard gates: four measurements (encapsulated-to-free uptake ratio, capsule service life in real effluent, phosphorus speciation of the Bio-Oils stream, enzyme leaching per cycle) must exist before Phase 2 opens, and at least one customer willing to pay the quoted price is required before scale-up rather than after. After the Jamboree: incorporation, a university technology-transfer novelty and freedom-to-operate assessment before deciding what to protect, a 12-month host-site pilot, then contract manufacturing, with the stated test that 'until repeat orders and positive unit economics without grant support both hold, rePhlow is a funded project rather than a company'.
good.realWorld_zh: 需求是用自己的資料撐起來的，不是貼一排機構標誌：已評估的內陸水體中有 63% 已呈優養化、約 115 萬 km2 的沿岸水域具優養化潛勢，並以西班牙的 Mar Menor 為具名案例，2016 年的一次藻華摧毀了超過 80% 的海草床，當地所得相對於未受影響地區下降了一定比例，房地產價值也隨之下跌。團隊實地走訪了 Mar Menor、Donana 與 Embalse de San Juan 來讓這些數字落地。九組 SDG 交互作用以 Nilsson、Griggs 與 Visbeck 的七點量表框架評分，涵蓋 SDG 6、9、12、13 與 14；22 場利害關係人對話則以改編自 iGEM Hangzhou-BioX 2024 的永續模式圖追蹤，其中六場可追溯到具體的工程決策，未閉合的迴圈也標記為未閉合。這一頁最可信的單一舉動是自我否證：團隊自己那份涵蓋 16 個衝擊類別的 ISO 14040/44 openLCA 研究發現，在他們實際達到的膠囊負載量（1.5 mg P/g）下，rePhlow 的氣候變遷衝擊高於化學沉澱的對照方案；研究指認每公克膠囊所捕集的磷量是唯一能翻轉結論的變數，並公開了約 8 mg P/g 的交叉點，而不是去列舉一項自家儀器數據並不支持的成就。法規被當成策略而非背景處理：歐盟指令 (EU) 2024/3019 將自 2027 年 8 月起取代都市廢水處理指令，磷限值分階段於 2033 至 2045 年生效，但團隊指出對其客戶具約束力的其實是廠區許可，而不是這份都市指令；他們也指出歐盟法規區分基改微生物的封閉使用與刻意釋放，使包覆加上下游超過濾既是安全措施，也同時是一條法規路徑；封閉使用通報有實際的 45 天與 90 天行政前置時間，而這些時間被放進了關鍵路徑。成本模型在 TRL 2-3 階段被明確陳述為假設而非結果：商業計畫 V3 給出每模組 9,460 EUR 的直接成本、50.2% 的毛利率，一座先導廠需 69,800 EUR 設備費加 450,000 EUR 現金成本，以及 20,000 EUR 的創辦人資本，後者對應國家級技術公司補助方案所要求的最低實收資本（在預算 >= 175,000 EUR 時最高補助 70%、上限 250,000 EUR），並明確以實驗室價格與工業大宗價格各做一次銷貨成本敏感度分析。團隊提出兩種營收模式：直接購買模組加耗材與服務，或 Phosphorus-as-a-Service，由 rePhlow 保留所有權，因此也自行承擔膠囊壽命的風險。灘頭堡市場是中型農工業與生質燃料廠，Bio-Oils Huelva 為第一個潛在客戶；四階段計畫設有硬性關卡：在第 2 階段開啟之前，必須先有四項量測（包覆與游離狀態的吸收比、膠囊在真實廢水中的使用壽命、Bio-Oils 廢水流的磷型態分析、每個循環的酶流失量），而且在放大量產之前、而非之後，必須至少有一個願意以報價付費的客戶。Jamboree 之後的規劃是：公司登記、在決定要保護什麼之前先做一次校內技轉的新穎性與自由實施評估、為期 12 個月的駐場先導運行，之後才進入委外製造；他們並明白立下檢驗標準：「在重複訂單與不靠補助也成立的正向單位經濟同時出現之前，rePhlow 都只是一個拿到資金的專案，而不是一家公司」。

gemsTakeaway: Copy Madrid's five-rung integration ladder with its closure rule: a stakeholder loop counts as closed only when the revised design has been taken back to the person who triggered the change and their response produces a further change. Copy also their willingness to publish an LCA that currently rules against their own technology, with the single reversing variable and its crossover value named.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 抄下 Madrid 的五階整合階梯以及它的閉環判準：一個利害關係人迴圈只有在修改後的設計被帶回給當初促成改變的那個人、而對方的回應又再引發一次改變時，才算真正閉合。也抄下他們願意公開一份目前判定對自家技術不利的 LCA，並明確指出那個唯一能翻轉結論的變數及其交叉點數值。
